title: Wire the managed-cache posture into the resume watchdogs
body:
## Current state
The watchdog ignores the managed-cache posture flag entirely.

## Scope
Flip the default and thread it through.

## Done condition
The watchdog reads the posture on every tick.

## Witness
go test ./cmd/fak -run Watchdog passes with the posture on.

## Likely files
cmd/fak/guard_startup.go

title: Teach the broker to backfill account cooldown from the ledger
body:
## Current state
Cooldown is recomputed from scratch each launch.

## Scope
Read the prior cooldown out of the probe ledger.

## Done condition
A relaunched broker keeps the prior cooldown.

## Witness
go test ./internal/accountprobe passes.

## Likely files
internal/accountprobe/probe_ledger.go

title: Render the fleet pane headroom column in the info tab
body:
## Current state
The info tab omits per-account headroom.

## Scope
Add a headroom column sourced from the roster.

## Done condition
The info tab shows a headroom column.

## Witness
go test ./cmd/fak -run InfoTabs passes.

## Likely files
cmd/fak/info_tabs_render.go
